definitions.explanation: One's mental attitude or approach toward doing something properly. Refers to the conscious effort to keep something in mind and act accordingly.

examples.japanese: {日頃|ひごろ}の{心掛|こころが}けが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
{健康|けんこう}に{良|よ}い{心掛|こころが}けをしている。
examples.english: I make an effort to maintain good health habits.

examples.japanese: その{心掛|こころが}けは{立派|りっぱ}だ。

notes:
FORMATION:
{心|こころ} (heart/mind) + {掛|か}け (hanging on, keeping)
→ Something kept in one's mind/heart

RELATED VERB:
{心掛|こころが}ける - to keep in mind, to try to, to make a point of
・{早|はや}く{寝|ね}るよう{心掛|こころが}けている (I make a point of going to bed early)

USAGE:
・{日頃|ひごろ}の{心掛|こころが}け - everyday attitude/habits
・{良|よ}い{心掛|こころが}け - good intentions/attitude
・{心掛|こころが}け{次第|しだい}だ - It depends on one's attitude

NUANCE:
Refers not just to intentions but to the conscious effort to maintain a certain attitude or practice habitually. Often used when praising someone's diligence or discipline.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{心構|こころがま}え - Mental preparedness, readiness
・{心得|こころえ} - Knowledge, understanding, rules to follow
・{姿勢|しせい} - Posture, attitude (figurative)
